title: chromolaena quercetorum
intro: Chromolaena quercetorum, commonly known as Tree Senna, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its reported health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Chromolaena quercetorum include analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its use in treating pain and fever. The bioactive constituents of Chromolaena quercetorum include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
